tool_signatures.name: cache-control (string, optional)

tool_signatures.name: cache-control (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Use no-cache to request fresh content

tool_signatures.name: count (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Number of results to return (1-50, default 20).

tool_signatures.name: count (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Maximum number of search results considered (1-50)

tool_signatures.name: geoloc (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Optional geolocation token used to refine results.

tool_signatures.name: goggles (string or array, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Goggle URL or definition for custom re-ranking

tool_signatures.name: key (string, required)
tool_signatures.description: Summary key from web search results

tool_signatures.name: latitude (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Latitude of the search center (-90 to 90). Typically paired with longitude.

tool_signatures.name: location (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Location string used as an alternative to latitude/longitude. For US locations prefer the form <city> <state> <country name> (e.g., san francisco ca united states); for non-US locations use <city> <country name> (e.g., tokyo japan).

tool_signatures.name: longitude (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Longitude of the search center (-180 to 180). Typically paired with latitude.

tool_signatures.name: maximum_number_of_snippets (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Maximum number of snippets to include (1-256)

tool_signatures.name: maximum_number_of_tokens (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Approximate maximum number of context tokens (1024-32768)

tool_signatures.name: maximum_number_of_urls (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Maximum number of URLs to include (1-50)

tool_signatures.name: query (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Query string used to refine the POI search (max 400 chars, 50 words). When omitted, returns general points of interest in the supplied area.

tool_signatures.name: radius (number, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Search radius around the supplied coordinates, in meters. If omitted, the search is performed globally.

tool_signatures.name: safesearch (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Safe search level (off, moderate, strict, default strict).

tool_signatures.name: spellcheck (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Whether to spellcheck the query (default true).

tool_signatures.name: summary (boolean, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Enable summary key generation for AI summarization

tool_signatures.name: units (string, optional)
tool_signatures.description: Distance units (metric or imperial, default metric).
